_about: Comfort (Dave 2026-10-31, from Valheim): the level a player enjoys near furniture and fire, and the Rested buff earned at a comfortable level. DESIGN AND DATA by Sal; server code by Tyler; models by Kathleen. Read by nothing yet. See docs/COMFORT_DESIGN.md for the rules and the code spec.

counts: inside a built roof (lean-to, roof piece)
under a grown tree crown (Cover.at, trees at 80 percent of species height)
shelter.note: The player must be sheltered for any furniture to count. Standing near the items is enough; you do not have to be in the lean-to.

rules.one_bed_counts: only the best bed within the radius counts (you sleep in one)
rules.lit_only: fires, torches and chandeliers count only while lit; a laid, unlit or burnt-out fire gives 0
rules.same_floor: items within height_m above or below the player's feet

kinds.source: campfire (structure live; counts only while lit)

earned_by: sleep or lie in a bed at that level
sit on a seat at that level for 30 s
lie on the ground at level 2 or more for 60 s (shorter buff)
rested.note: A game hour is 2.5 real minutes: 45 real minutes is 18 game hours. A new buff of a higher or equal level refreshes the timer and sets the tier; it never stacks.
rested.duration_note: Dave 31 Oct: the buff ALWAYS lasts the same time, about 45 REAL minutes; the comfort level scales the BONUSES, not the time. Game-time length is computed from the game clock (GameClock.RATIO = 24 game hours per real hour, so 45 real minutes = 18 game hours); never hard-code game units. Resting again refreshes the 45 minutes while the comfort level is at least that of the current buff (a higher level replaces the tier); resting at a lower level changes nothing.
rested.refresh_rule: on a completed rest at level L: if no buff, or L >= buff.level: buff = {level: L, until: now + 45 real minutes}; else leave it

bed_json_fold: data/items/bed.json comfort 1 for the rough bed stays; its regen_mult 1.25 and drain_mult 0.5 are the SLEEP bonus and stack with Rested only for regen (take the larger, do not multiply) so a comfortable bed cannot double up.

hud.comfort_icon: a hearth icon with the level number; grey at 0 to 1, warm at 2 and above
hud.rested_icon: a moon-and-cup icon with a countdown in minutes
tooltip: Missing: a rug, a lit torch (+2 more)
Rested: +20% health regeneration, -15% exhaustion, 24 min left

messages.unsheltered: You are not sheltered: nothing here comforts you.
messages.low: It is too bare to rest well here (comfort 2 needed).
